1)\n\n    model.to(device=device, dtype=dtype)\n\n    # Buffers for AFAB: retain all forward graphs until all backward passes complete.\n    fwd_outputs = []   # Local forward output tensors; used as roots for .backward()\n    recv_tensors = []  # Received leaf tensors with requires_grad (all non-first ranks)\n    losses = []        # Scaled cross-entropy losses (last rank only)\n\n    # ── ALL FORWARD PASSES ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    for mb_idx in range(num_microbatches):\n        mb_in = inputs[mb_idx].to(device)\n        mb, sq = mb_in.shape[0], mb_in.shape[1]\n\n        if rank == 0:\n            # First stage: embed input tokens then run local transformer layers.\n            hs = model.model.embed_tokens(mb_in).to(dtype)\n            for layer in my_layers:\n                hs = layer(hs)[0]\n\n            if is_last:\n                # world_size == 1: this rank also handles the final projection.\n                logits = model.lm_head(model.model.norm(hs))\n                loss = F.cross_entropy(\n                    logits.view(-1, logits.size(-1)),\n                    targets[mb_idx].to(device).view(-1),\n                ) / num_microbatches\n                losses.append(loss)\n            else:\n                # Send detached hidden states to next stage.\n                buf = hs.detach().contiguous()\n                reqs = dist.batch_isend_irecv([P2POp(dist.isend, buf, rank + 1)])\n                for r in reqs:\n                    r.wait()\n\n            fwd_outputs.append(hs)\n\n        else:\n            # Non-first stages: receive hidden states from the previous stage.\n            recv_buf = torch.zeros(mb, sq, hidden_size, device=device, dtype=dtype)\n            reqs = dist.batch_isend_irecv([P2POp(dist.irecv, recv_buf, rank - 1)])\n            for r in reqs:\n                r.wait()\n\n            # Make received buffer a leaf tensor so .grad is populated during backward.\n            recv_buf.requires_grad_(True)\n            recv_tensors.append(recv_buf)\n\n            hs = recv_buf\n            for layer in my_layers:\n                hs = layer(hs)[0]\n\n            if is_last:\n                # Last stage: apply final norm, project to vocab, compute scaled loss.\n                logits = model.lm_head(model.model.norm(hs))\n                loss = F.cross_entropy(\n                    logits.view(-1, logits.size(-1)),\n                    targets[mb_idx].to(device).view(-1),\n                ) / num_microbatches\n                losses.append(loss)\n            else:\n                # Middle stage: forward detached hidden states to next stage.\n                buf = hs.detach().contiguous()\n                reqs = dist.batch_isend_irecv([P2POp(dist.isend, buf, rank + 1)])\n                for r in reqs:\n                    r.wait()\n\n            fwd_outputs.append(hs)\n\n    # ── ALL BACKWARD PASSES ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n    for mb_idx in range(num_microbatches):\n        mb, sq = inputs[mb_idx].shape[0], inputs[mb_idx].shape[1]\n\n        if is_last:\n            # Differentiate through local layers from the loss.\n            losses[mb_idx].backward()\n\n            if world_size > 1:\n                # Gradient at the stage boundary flows back to the previous rank.\n                grad = recv_tensors[mb_idx].grad.contiguous()\n                reqs = dist.batch_isend_irecv([P2POp(dist.isend, grad, rank - 1)])\n                for r in reqs:\n                    r.wait()\n\n        elif rank == 0:\n            # Receive incoming gradient from the next stage.\n            grad_buf = torch.zeros(mb, sq, hidden_size, device=device, dtype=dtype)\n            reqs = dist.batch_isend_irecv([P2POp(dist.irecv, grad_buf, rank + 1)])\n            for r in reqs:\n                r.wait()\n\n            # Propagate gradients through embedding and local layers.\n            fwd_outputs[mb_idx].backward(grad_buf)\n\n        else:\n            # Middle stage: receive gradient from next, backward locally, send to prev.\n            grad_buf = torch.zeros(mb, sq, hidden_size, device=device, dtype=dtype)\n            reqs = dist.batch_isend_irecv([P2POp(dist.irecv, grad_buf, rank + 1)])\n            for r in reqs:\n                r.wait()\n\n            fwd_outputs[mb_idx].backward(grad_buf)\n\n            grad = recv_tensors[mb_idx].grad.contiguous()\n            reqs = dist.batch_isend_irecv([P2POp(dist.isend, grad, rank - 1)])\n            for r in reqs:\n                r.wait()\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}
